request_arrival_process: exponential inter-arrival with mean 24/rate hours; truncated when next arrival would exceed the horizon
lookback_boundary_semantics: A prior notification at time t is counted in N_recent_alerts at query time T iff T - lookback_days <= t <= T (closed interval). Ranking queries T = emergency request_timestamp before any dispatch in that emergency.
sensitivity_status: exploratory; not a confirmatory multiplicity-controlled analysis

response_model.latency: lognormal(mu=2.0, sigma=0.8), min 1 minute; recent_alerts argument left at default 0

omitted_longitudinal_clinical_constraint: No post-donation 8-week deferral update after simulated arrival
Eligibility is a static synthetic 90% flag assigned at profile construction
No haemoglobin, infection, or age-based deferral rules
simulated_current_availability is not used as a hard dispatch filter
information_separation: Ranker sees travel time, eligibility, blood-compatibility-filtered pool, synthetic_response_propensity (same optimistic P used in Phase 4/5), and N_recent_alerts. Ranker does not see future accept/decline outcomes, sampled latency, or arrival events.
